subject: Re: Encord Invite
text:
Hello Yuvi,

Thank you for the invite. I sent a proposal for July 8 at 3pm IST. We're a
robotics startup working with visual AI models for food preparation. Our
primary data workflows involve image classification, object detection, and
semantic segmentation, across a growing dataset of cooking scenarios with
varying lighting and surface conditions. My team is currently focusing on
the following areas:

   - Semi-automatic annotation: ingesting pre-labels from our own trained
   models or foundation model heads, with low-confidence routing for human
   review
   - Dataset curation: embedding-based diversity selection and
   near-duplicate detection on temporally redundant video frames
   - QA workflow: label validation, consensus/agreement metrics, and
   correction export loop
   - Native segmentation mask annotation and review (not just bounding
   boxes)
   - Support for self-supervised/foundation-model pretraining on unlabeled
   data

Looking forward to speaking with you soon.

Best regards,
Karthik.
